entries.example: 我的駕照筆試合格了！
entries.exampleEnglish: I passed the written part of my driving test!
entries.question: 你考駕照的時候，一次就合格了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you took your driving test, did you pass the first time?
entries.answer: 對，我第一次考就合格了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I passed on my first try.

entries.example: 我們公司常跟日本公司合作。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company often works with Japanese companies.
entries.question: 你喜歡跟別人合作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like working with other people?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我覺得跟同事合作很有趣。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I find working with my coworkers fun.

entries.example: 停車場在地下二樓。
entries.exampleEnglish: The parking lot is on basement level two.
entries.question: 你常去台北車站的地下街嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to the underground mall at Taipei Main Station?
entries.answer: 常去，地下街有很多好吃的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the underground mall has lots of good food.

entries.example: 這部電影又長又乏味。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is long and dull.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼工作很乏味？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of work do you find tedious?
entries.answer: 我覺得一直輸入資料很乏味。
entries.answerEnglish: I find typing in data all day tedious.

entries.example: 他刻意不回我的訊息。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's deliberately not answering my messages.
entries.question: 你會刻意少吃甜的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make a point of eating fewer sweet things?
entries.answer: 會，我最近刻意少喝含糖飲料。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lately I've been deliberately drinking fewer sugary drinks.

entries.example: 過年前我們把家裡徹底打掃了一遍。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before Lunar New Year we gave the whole house a thorough cleaning.
entries.question: 你多久徹底打掃一次家裡？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you clean your home thoroughly?
entries.answer: 我大概一個月徹底打掃一次。
entries.answerEnglish: I do a thorough clean about once a month.

entries.example: 我感冒了，一直咳嗽。
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a cold and keep coughing.
entries.question: 你咳嗽的時候會怎麼做？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you have a cough?
entries.answer: 我咳嗽的時候會多喝溫水。
entries.answerEnglish: When I have a cough, I drink lots of warm water.

entries.example: 天氣逐漸變冷了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather is gradually getting colder.
entries.question: 你逐漸習慣台灣的生活了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you gradually getting used to life in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 是的，我已經逐漸習慣這裡的生活了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm gradually getting used to life here.

entries.example: 他說那句話沒有惡意。
entries.exampleEnglish: He didn't mean anything bad by saying that.
entries.question: 網路上的惡意留言，你會在意嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do nasty comments online bother you?
entries.answer: 不會，我不太在意網路上的惡意留言。
entries.answerEnglish: No, nasty comments online don't really bother me.

entries.example: 我要下班了，再見！
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm heading home from work now. Bye!
entries.question: 下班的時候，你跟同事說什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you say to your coworkers when you leave work?
entries.answer: 我跟同事說：「再見！」
entries.answerEnglish: I say "Goodbye!" to my coworkers.

entries.example: 這裡以前是一間廢棄的工廠。
entries.exampleEnglish: This used to be an abandoned factory.
entries.question: 你去過廢棄的建築嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been to an abandoned building?
entries.answer: 去過，我去過一間廢棄的老醫院，很可怕。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once went to an abandoned old hospital. It was scary.

entries.example: 我的老闆很幽默。
entries.exampleEnglish: My boss is very funny.
entries.question: 你覺得自己幽默嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have a good sense of humor?
entries.answer: 我覺得我還滿幽默的。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty funny.

entries.example: 夜市有很多油炸的食物。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's lots of deep-fried food at the night market.
entries.question: 你常吃油炸的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often eat deep-fried food?
entries.answer: 不常，油炸的東西不太健康。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. Deep-fried food isn't very healthy.

entries.example: 網路上的謠言不要隨便相信。
entries.exampleEnglish: Don't just believe the rumors you see online.
entries.question: 你聽過關於公司的謠言嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you heard any rumors about your company?
entries.answer: 聽過，可是我覺得那只是謠言。
entries.answerEnglish: I have, but I think it's just a rumor.

entries.example: 這道菜很有家鄉風味。
entries.exampleEnglish: This dish really tastes like home.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪種風味的料理？
entries.questionEnglish: What style of cooking do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡泰式風味的料理。
entries.answerEnglish: I like Thai-style food best.

entries.example: 我的錢包裡還有幾個英國便士。
entries.exampleEnglish: I still have a few British pennies in my wallet.
entries.question: 你用過英國的便士嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used British pennies?
entries.answer: 用過，我還留著幾個便士當紀念。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I still keep a few pennies as souvenirs.

entries.example: 我家離公司五公里。
entries.exampleEnglish: My home is five kilometers from the office.
entries.question: 你家離公司幾公里？
entries.questionEnglish: How many kilometers is your home from work?
entries.answer: 我家離公司大概三公里。
entries.answerEnglish: My home is about three kilometers from work.

entries.example: 現在很少人用光碟聽音樂了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Hardly anyone listens to music on CDs anymore.
entries.question: 你家裡還有光碟嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still have any CDs at home?
entries.answer: 有，我還有很多音樂光碟。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I still have lots of music CDs.

entries.example: 我完全聽不懂台語。
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't understand Taiwanese at all.
entries.question: 你完全習慣台灣的天氣了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you completely used to Taiwan's weather?
entries.answer: 還沒有完全習慣，夏天太熱了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not completely. Summer is too hot.

entries.english: take part in; participate; get involved
entries.example: 我很想參與這個計畫。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'd really like to be part of this project.
entries.question: 你參與過什麼志工活動？
entries.questionEnglish: What volunteer activities have you taken part in?
entries.answer: 我參與過海邊的淨灘活動。
entries.answerEnglish: I've taken part in a beach cleanup.

entries.example: 開會的時候他一直很沉默。
entries.exampleEnglish: He stayed silent the whole meeting.
entries.question: 開會時，你常常保持沉默嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often stay silent in meetings?
entries.answer: 如果我不懂，我就會保持沉默。
entries.answerEnglish: If I don't understand, I stay silent.

entries.example: 這兩個方法本質上是一樣的。
entries.exampleEnglish: These two methods are essentially the same.
entries.question: 你覺得工作和學習本質上一樣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think working and studying are essentially the same?
entries.answer: 我覺得本質上差不多，都需要努力。
entries.answerEnglish: I think they're essentially similar; both take effort.

entries.example: 我到捷運站，車正好來了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Just as I got to the MRT station, the train arrived.
entries.question: 今天的天氣對你來說正好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is today's weather just right for you?
entries.answer: 正好，不冷也不熱。
entries.answerEnglish: It's just right, not cold and not hot.

entries.example: 我想跟朋友合夥開咖啡店。
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to open a coffee shop together with a friend.
entries.question: 你會跟朋友合夥做生意嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you go into business with a friend?
entries.answer: 不會，我怕跟朋友合夥會吵架。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm afraid we'd end up fighting if we were partners.

entries.example: 我在捷運上遺失了錢包。
entries.exampleEnglish: I lost my wallet on the MRT.
entries.question: 你遺失過什麼重要的東西？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever lost anything important?
entries.answer: 我遺失過護照，非常麻煩。
entries.answerEnglish: I once lost my passport. It was a huge hassle.

entries.example: 請假要先交書面申請。
entries.exampleEnglish: To take leave, you need to hand in a written request first.
entries.question: 你們公司請假要寫書面申請嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company require a written request to take leave?
entries.answer: 要，我們要先交書面申請。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we have to hand in a written request first.

entries.example: 這部電影在講一個謀殺案。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is about a murder case.
entries.question: 你喜歡看有謀殺案的推理小說嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like mystery novels about murders?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛看謀殺案的小說。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, murder mysteries are my favorite.

entries.example: 我對這間房子很滿意。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm very happy with this apartment.
entries.question: 你對現在的工作滿意嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you satisfied with your current job?
entries.answer: 很滿意，同事都對我很好。
entries.answerEnglish: Very satisfied. My coworkers are all good to me.

entries.example: 餐廳今天沒開，我好失望。
entries.exampleEnglish: The restaurant was closed today. I was so disappointed.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你失望？
entries.questionEnglish: What kinds of things disappoint you?
entries.answer: 朋友遲到會讓我很失望。
entries.answerEnglish: It disappoints me when friends are late.

entries.example: 這杯果汁混合了三種水果。
entries.exampleEnglish: This juice is a blend of three fruits.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝混合果汁嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like mixed fruit juice?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常喝混合果汁。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often drink mixed juice.

entries.example: 她的態度很堅定。
entries.exampleEnglish: She was very firm about it.
entries.question: 你學中文的決心堅定嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: How firm is your determination to learn Chinese?
entries.answer: 很堅定，我一定要學好中文。
entries.answerEnglish: Very firm. I'm going to learn Chinese well no matter what.

entries.example: 他打籃球的時候受傷了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He got hurt playing basketball.
entries.question: 你運動的時候受傷過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been injured while exercising?
entries.answer: 有，我跑步的時候受傷過。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got injured once while running.

entries.example: 我們公司的球隊獲勝了！
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company team won!
entries.question: 你玩遊戲常常獲勝嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often win when you play games?
entries.answer: 不常，我玩桌遊很少獲勝。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I rarely win at board games.

entries.example: 這家民宿常有外國旅人來住。
entries.exampleEnglish: Foreign travelers often stay at this guesthouse.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是什麼樣的旅人？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of traveler do you think you are?
entries.answer: 我是喜歡慢慢走的旅人。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm the kind of traveler who likes to take it slow.

entries.example: 這份文件要印彩色的嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Should this document be printed in color?
entries.question: 你喜歡穿彩色的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing colorful clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我有很多彩色的衣服。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have lots of colorful clothes.

entries.example: 我哥哥很喜歡看賽車。
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother loves watching car racing.
entries.question: 你看過賽車比賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever watched a car race?
entries.answer: 看過，我在電視上看過賽車。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've watched car racing on TV.

entries.example: 昨天的颱風好嚇人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Yesterday's typhoon was really scary.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼電影最嚇人？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of movie do you find scariest?
entries.answer: 我覺得日本的鬼片最嚇人。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Japanese ghost movies are the scariest.

entries.example: 坐電梯往上到十樓。
entries.exampleEnglish: Take the elevator up to the tenth floor.
entries.question: 你回家要往上爬樓梯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to climb stairs to get home?
entries.answer: 要，我要往上爬四層樓。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to climb up four floors.

entries.example: 台灣有很多特有的物種。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has many species found nowhere else.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台灣的哪個物種？
entries.questionEnglish: Which of Taiwan's species do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡台灣黑熊這個物種。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite species is the Formosan black bear.

entries.example: 這裡是看夕陽的絕佳地點。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a perfect spot for watching the sunset.
entries.question: 你知道哪裡是看夜景的絕佳地點？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know a great spot for night views?
entries.answer: 象山是看夜景的絕佳地點。
entries.answerEnglish: Elephant Mountain is a great spot for night views.

entries.example: 簽約前要仔細看清楚條款。
entries.exampleEnglish: Read the terms carefully before you sign a contract.
entries.question: 你簽約前會看清楚所有條款嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read all the terms carefully before signing a contract?
entries.answer: 會，我一定會先看完所有條款。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always read all the terms first.

entries.example: 我們先用現有的資料就好。
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's just use the data we already have for now.
entries.question: 你對現有的手機滿意嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you happy with the phone you have now?
entries.answer: 滿意，現有的手機還很好用。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my current phone still works well.

entries.example: 老闆聽完就點頭說好。
entries.exampleEnglish: After listening, the boss nodded and said OK.
entries.question: 你同意別人的時候會點頭嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you nod when you agree with someone?
entries.answer: 會，我常常點頭。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I nod a lot.

entries.example: 開店前要先了解相關法規。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before opening a shop, you need to understand the relevant regulations.
entries.question: 你了解台灣的交通法規嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: How well do you know Taiwan's traffic regulations?
entries.answer: 了解一些，考駕照的時候學過交通法規。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit. I learned the traffic rules when I took my driving test.

entries.example: 他在一家大企業上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: He works at a big company.
entries.question: 你想在大企業還是小公司工作？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you rather work at a big company or a small one?
entries.answer: 我想在大企業工作。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to work at a big company.

entries.example: 媽祖是台灣重要的民間信仰。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mazu is an important part of Taiwan's folk religion.
entries.question: 你知道哪些台灣的民間故事？
entries.questionEnglish: Which Taiwanese folk tales do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道虎姑婆這個民間故事。
entries.answerEnglish: I know the folk tale of Grandaunt Tiger.

entries.example: 海裡有很多奇怪的生物。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of strange creatures in the sea.
entries.question: 你最怕哪種生物？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of creature are you most afraid of?
entries.answer: 我最怕蟑螂這種生物。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most afraid of cockroaches.

entries.example: 這個小鎮仰賴觀光客生活。
entries.exampleEnglish: This small town depends on tourists to survive.
entries.question: 你的工作很仰賴電腦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your work rely heavily on computers?
entries.answer: 對，我的工作非常仰賴電腦。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my work depends heavily on computers.

entries.example: 我們的團隊由五個人組成。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our team is made up of five people.
entries.question: 你的家庭由幾個人組成？
entries.questionEnglish: How many people make up your family?
entries.answer: 我的家庭由四個人組成。
entries.answerEnglish: My family is made up of four people.

entries.example: 這家店只賣本土的水果。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop only sells locally grown fruit.
entries.question: 你喜歡台灣本土的品牌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like Taiwan's homegrown brands?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常買本土品牌的衣服。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often buy clothes from local brands.

entries.example: 政府應該照顧人民的福祉。
entries.exampleEnglish: The government should look after the people's well-being.
entries.question: 你覺得你的公司重視員工福祉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your company cares about employee well-being?
entries.answer: 我覺得我們公司很重視員工福祉。
entries.answerEnglish: I think our company cares a lot about employee well-being.

entries.example: 她的事業做得很成功。
entries.exampleEnglish: Her career has been very successful.
entries.question: 你覺得事業和家庭哪個重要？
entries.questionEnglish: Which do you think matters more, career or family?
entries.answer: 我覺得家庭比事業重要。
entries.answerEnglish: I think family matters more than career.

entries.example: 她買了一雙金色的鞋子。
entries.exampleEnglish: She bought a pair of gold shoes.
entries.question: 你喜歡金色的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like gold-colored things?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，我覺得金色太亮了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I think gold is too flashy.

entries.example: 這個國家的政權換了好幾次。
entries.exampleEnglish: Power in this country has changed hands several times.
entries.question: 你的國家最近政權有改變嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has there been a change of government in your country recently?
entries.answer: 有，去年選舉以後政權輪替了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, power changed hands after last year's election.

entries.example: 這間是天主教的教堂。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a Catholic church.
entries.question: 你的家人信天主教嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is anyone in your family Catholic?
entries.answer: 我媽媽信天主教。
entries.answerEnglish: My mom is Catholic.

entries.example: 我爸爸週末常打高爾夫球。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad often plays golf on weekends.
entries.question: 你打過高爾夫球嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played golf?
entries.answer: 打過一次高爾夫球，可是很難。
entries.answerEnglish: I played golf once, but it was hard.

entries.example: 評審團選出了今年最好的電影。
entries.exampleEnglish: The jury chose this year's best film.
entries.question: 你參加過有評審團的比賽嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever entered a competition with a panel of judges?
entries.answer: 參加過，評審團給了我很高的分數。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the judges gave me a high score.

entries.example: 這份報告要用百分比表示。
entries.exampleEnglish: This report should show the figures as percentages.
entries.question: 你每個月存多少百分比的薪水？
entries.questionEnglish: What percentage of your salary do you save each month?
entries.answer: 我存的百分比不高，大約百分之十。
entries.answerEnglish: Not a high percentage, about ten percent.

entries.example: 我們先假定明天不會下雨。
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's assume for now that it won't rain tomorrow.
entries.question: 計畫旅行時，你會假定天氣很好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you plan a trip, do you assume the weather will be good?
entries.answer: 不會，我不會假定天氣一定很好。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I never assume the weather will be good.

entries.example: 我爸爸下個月要動手術。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad is having surgery next month.
entries.question: 你動過手術嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had surgery?
entries.answer: 動過，我小時候動過一次手術。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had an operation once when I was little.

entries.example: 台灣有很多不同的族群。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has many different ethnic groups.
entries.question: 你的國家有幾個主要族群？
entries.questionEnglish: How many main ethnic groups are there in your country?
entries.answer: 我的國家有三個主要族群。
entries.answerEnglish: My country has three main ethnic groups.

entries.example: 台灣人很喜歡看棒球。
entries.exampleEnglish: People in Taiwan love watching baseball.
entries.question: 你喜歡看棒球嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching baseball?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常去看棒球比賽。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to baseball games.

entries.english: implement; put into effect; carry out
entries.example: 公司下個月開始實施新規定。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company will start enforcing the new rules next month.
entries.question: 你們公司有實施在家上班嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your company introduced working from home?
entries.answer: 有，公司去年開始實施了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the company started it last year.

entries.example: 他長得高，是因為基因好。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's tall because he has good genes.
entries.question: 你覺得個性是基因決定的嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think personality is decided by genes?
entries.answer: 一部分是基因，一部分是環境。
entries.answerEnglish: Partly genes, partly environment.

entries.example: 運動可以幫我消除壓力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Exercise helps me get rid of stress.
entries.question: 你用什麼方法消除壓力？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you relieve stress?
entries.answer: 我用跑步來消除壓力。
entries.answerEnglish: I go running to relieve stress.

entries.example: 這台機械壞了，要找人來修。
entries.exampleEnglish: This machine is broken; we need someone to fix it.
entries.question: 你對機械有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in machines?
entries.answer: 有，我很喜歡研究機械。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love figuring out how machines work.

entries.example: 我們沿著山上的小徑慢慢走。
entries.exampleEnglish: We walked slowly along the mountain trail.
entries.question: 你喜歡走森林裡的小徑嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like walking on forest trails?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我週末常走陽明山的小徑。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, on weekends I often walk the trails on Yangmingshan.

entries.example: 他在報告裡引用了很多數據。
entries.exampleEnglish: He cited a lot of data in his report.
entries.question: 你寫文章時常引用名言嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often quote famous sayings when you write?
entries.answer: 不常，我很少引用名言。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I rarely quote famous sayings.

entries.example: 你有發燒的症狀嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Do you have a fever?
entries.question: 你感冒的時候有什麼症狀？
entries.questionEnglish: What symptoms do you get when you have a cold?
entries.answer: 我的症狀是喉嚨痛和咳嗽。
entries.answerEnglish: My symptoms are a sore throat and a cough.

entries.example: 我一眼就認出她了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I recognized her at a glance.
entries.question: 你有一眼就愛上的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything you fell in love with at first sight?
entries.answer: 有，我一眼就愛上了現在的房子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I fell in love with my current home the moment I saw it.

entries.example: 山上收訊不好，電話打不通。
entries.exampleEnglish: The reception is bad up in the mountains, so calls don't go through.
entries.question: 你家的手機收訊好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the phone reception good at your place?
entries.answer: 不太好，我房間的收訊很差。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. The reception in my room is bad.

entries.example: 現在是網路時代。
entries.exampleEnglish: We live in the internet age.
entries.question: 你最想活在哪個時代？
entries.questionEnglish: Which era would you most like to live in?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡現在這個時代。
entries.answerEnglish: I like the times we live in now best.

entries.example: 我的童年是在鄉下過的。
entries.exampleEnglish: I spent my childhood in the countryside.
entries.question: 你的童年快樂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Was your childhood happy?
entries.answer: 很快樂，我的童年常在海邊玩。
entries.answerEnglish: Very happy. I spent a lot of my childhood playing by the sea.

entries.example: 這家公司在台北設立了新辦公室。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company set up a new office in Taipei.
entries.question: 你的公司在台灣設立多久了？
entries.questionEnglish: How long has your company been established in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我的公司在台灣設立十年了。
entries.answerEnglish: My company was set up in Taiwan ten years ago.

entries.example: 他的腳傷已經復原了。
entries.exampleEnglish: His foot injury has healed.
entries.question: 你生病後通常多久會復原？
entries.questionEnglish: How long does it usually take you to recover when you're sick?
entries.answer: 我感冒大概一週就會復原。
entries.answerEnglish: When I have a cold, I'm usually better in about a week.

entries.example: 我把椅子放低一點，比較舒服。
entries.exampleEnglish: I lowered my chair a bit; it's more comfortable.
entries.question: 跟長輩說話時，你會放低音量嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you lower your voice when talking to elders?
entries.answer: 會，我會放低音量，說話慢一點。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I lower my voice and speak more slowly.

entries.example: 這條街上有很多小畫廊。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of small galleries on this street.
entries.question: 你常去畫廊看畫嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to galleries to look at art?
entries.answer: 不常，我一年去一兩次畫廊。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I go to a gallery once or twice a year.

entries.example: 雞蛋有很多蛋白質。
entries.exampleEnglish: Eggs have lots of protein.
entries.question: 你平常吃什麼補充蛋白質？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually eat to get protein?
entries.answer: 我每天早上吃雞蛋補充蛋白質。
entries.answerEnglish: I eat eggs every morning for protein.

entries.example: 這個廣告很有創意。
entries.exampleEnglish: This ad is really creative.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有創意嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're creative?
entries.answer: 我覺得我滿有創意的。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm pretty creative.

entries.example: 這家餐廳拿到很高的評等。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant got a very high rating.
entries.question: 你選餐廳時會看評等嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check ratings when choosing a restaurant?
entries.answer: 會，我只去評等四顆星以上的餐廳。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I only go to restaurants rated four stars or above.

entries.example: 他是一位游泳運動員。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a competitive swimmer.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位運動員？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite athlete?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡台灣的羽球運動員。
entries.answerEnglish: I like Taiwan's badminton players best.

entries.example: 大家的意見很一致。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone was in agreement.
entries.question: 你和家人的想法常常一致嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you and your family usually see things the same way?
entries.answer: 不太一致，我們常常意見不同。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. We often disagree.

entries.example: 我自己組裝了這張書桌。
entries.exampleEnglish: I put this desk together myself.
entries.question: 你會自己組裝家具嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you assemble furniture yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我在IKEA買的家具都自己組裝。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I assemble all the furniture I buy at IKEA myself.

entries.example: 夜市有許多好吃的東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market has lots of tasty food.
entries.question: 你在台灣交了許多朋友嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you made many friends in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 對，我在台灣交了許多朋友。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've made lots of friends in Taiwan.

entries.example: 最近不景氣，生意很差。
entries.exampleEnglish: The economy's bad lately, and business is slow.
entries.question: 不景氣的時候，你會少花錢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you spend less when the economy is bad?
entries.answer: 會，不景氣的時候我會少出去吃飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when the economy is bad I eat out less.

entries.example: 開會前請先看一下議程。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please look over the agenda before the meeting.
entries.question: 你們開會前會先發議程嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you send out an agenda before meetings?
entries.answer: 會，主管會先把議程寄給大家。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our manager emails the agenda to everyone first.

entries.example: 我想提升我的中文能力。
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to improve my Chinese.
entries.question: 你想怎麼提升你的中文？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you want to improve your Chinese?
entries.answer: 我想多跟台灣人聊天來提升中文。
entries.answerEnglish: I want to chat more with Taiwanese people to improve my Chinese.

entries.example: 他小時候家裡很貧窮。
entries.exampleEnglish: His family was very poor when he was a child.
entries.question: 你覺得怎麼做能減少貧窮？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think can reduce poverty?
entries.answer: 我覺得教育可以減少貧窮。
entries.answerEnglish: I think education can reduce poverty.

entries.example: 我想出去走走，轉換一下心情。
entries.exampleEnglish: I want to go out for a walk and clear my head.
entries.question: 你想轉換工作跑道嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to switch careers?
entries.answer: 想，我想轉換跑道去當老師。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to switch careers and become a teacher.

entries.example: 有問題可以問服務人員。
entries.exampleEnglish: If you have questions, you can ask the staff.
entries.question: 你們公司有多少工作人員？
entries.questionEnglish: How many staff does your company have?
entries.answer: 我們公司有五十個工作人員。
entries.answerEnglish: Our company has fifty staff.

entries.example: 在捷運上吃東西會被罰款。
entries.exampleEnglish: You'll be fined for eating on the MRT.
entries.question: 你被罰款過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been fined?
entries.answer: 有，我亂停車被罰款過一次。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was fined once for illegal parking.

entries.example: 我們跟一家經銷商買了新車。
entries.exampleEnglish: We bought a new car from a dealer.
entries.question: 你買車時會比較不同的經銷商嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you buy a car, do you compare different dealers?
entries.answer: 會，我會多看幾家經銷商。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check out several dealers.

entries.example: 我騎腳踏車去上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: I ride my bike to work.
entries.question: 你常騎腳踏車嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often ride a bike?
entries.answer: 常騎，週末我騎腳踏車去河邊。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. On weekends I ride my bike to the riverside.

entries.example: 我哥哥在一家公司當顧問。
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother is a consultant at a company.
entries.question: 你想當顧問嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a consultant?
entries.answer: 想，我想當科技公司的顧問。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be a consultant for tech companies.

entries.example: 這次選舉有很多國外觀察員。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are many foreign observers at this election.
entries.question: 你當過活動的觀察員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been an observer at an event?
entries.answer: 沒有，我沒當過觀察員。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never been an observer.

entries.example: 他非常熱愛他的工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's really passionate about his job.
entries.question: 你熱愛什麼運動？
entries.questionEnglish: What sport are you passionate about?
entries.answer: 我熱愛爬山。
entries.answerEnglish: I love hiking.

entries.example: 週末我去醫院當志工。
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I volunteer at a hospital.
entries.question: 你當過志工嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever volunteered?
entries.answer: 當過，我在圖書館當過志工。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've volunteered at a library.

entries.example: 我剪頭髮都找同一位設計師。
entries.exampleEnglish: I always get my hair cut by the same stylist.
entries.question: 你想當設計師嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a designer?
entries.answer: 想，我想當室內設計師。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to be an interior designer.

entries.example: 墮胎在很多國家都有爭議。
entries.exampleEnglish: Abortion is controversial in many countries.
entries.question: 你的國家允許墮胎嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is abortion allowed in your country?
entries.answer: 允許，在我的國家墮胎是合法的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, abortion is legal in my country.

entries.example: 今年的畢業生很難找工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: This year's graduates are having a hard time finding jobs.
entries.question: 你是哪一年的大學畢業生？
entries.questionEnglish: What year did you graduate from university?
entries.answer: 我是2018年的大學畢業生。
entries.answerEnglish: I graduated from university in 2018.

entries.example: 她大學念的是文學。
entries.exampleEnglish: She studied literature at university.
entries.question: 你喜歡哪個國家的文學？
entries.questionEnglish: Which country's literature do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡日本文學。
entries.answerEnglish: I like Japanese literature.

entries.example: 今天中午的陽光很強烈。
entries.exampleEnglish: The midday sun is really strong today.
entries.question: 你有什麼強烈的願望嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there something you strongly wish for?
entries.answer: 有，我有一個強烈的願望，就是環島。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a strong wish to travel around the whole island.

entries.example: 這個小鎮主要靠農業。
entries.exampleEnglish: This small town relies mainly on farming.
entries.question: 你對農業有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in farming?
entries.answer: 有，我以後想在鄉下從事農業。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, someday I'd like to farm in the countryside.

entries.example: 電影裡的指揮官非常勇敢。
entries.exampleEnglish: The commander in the movie is very brave.
entries.question: 你覺得你適合當指揮官嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you'd make a good commander?
entries.answer: 不適合，我不想當指揮官。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I wouldn't want to be a commander.

entries.example: 我孩子學校的校長人很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: The principal at my kid's school is very nice.
entries.question: 你小時候的校長嚴格嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Was your principal strict when you were a child?
entries.answer: 很嚴格，我很怕我們的校長。
entries.answerEnglish: Very strict. I was scared of our principal.

entries.example: 請給我完整的資料。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please give me the complete information.
entries.question: 你讀過一本完整的中文小說嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever read a whole novel in Chinese?
entries.answer: 還沒，我只讀過完整的短篇故事。
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet. I've only read complete short stories.

entries.example: 颱風把樹枝折斷了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The typhoon snapped the tree branches.
entries.question: 你的雨傘被風折斷過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your umbrella ever been snapped by the wind?
entries.answer: 有，颱風天我的雨傘被折斷了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my umbrella snapped on a typhoon day.

entries.example: 台灣的戰略位置很重要。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan's strategic location is very important.
entries.question: 你玩遊戲時會想戰略嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think about strategy when you play games?
entries.answer: 會，我玩遊戲很重視戰略。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, strategy matters a lot to me when I play games.

entries.example: 我家樓下有一間診所。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a clinic downstairs from my place.
entries.question: 你生病時會去診所還是醫院？
entries.questionEnglish: When you're sick, do you go to a clinic or a hospital?
entries.answer: 我通常去家附近的診所。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually go to a clinic near my home.

entries.example: 有自殺的念頭時，一定要找人幫忙。
entries.exampleEnglish: If you have thoughts of suicide, be sure to reach out for help.
entries.question: 你的國家有自殺防治專線嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have a suicide prevention hotline?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家也有自殺防治專線。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country has a suicide prevention hotline too.

entries.example: 李白是很有名的詩人。
entries.exampleEnglish: Li Bai is a very famous poet.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪一位詩人？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite poet?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的詩人是李白。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite poet is Li Bai.

entries.example: 牆上掛著一幅爺爺的肖像畫。
entries.exampleEnglish: A portrait of Grandpa hangs on the wall.
entries.question: 你想請人幫你畫肖像畫嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to have your portrait painted?
entries.answer: 想，我想在夜市請人畫肖像畫。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to get a portrait done at a night market.

entries.example: 這碗湯裡有很多豆子。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of beans in this soup.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃豆子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like eating beans?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常吃豆子做的甜點。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often eat desserts made with beans.

entries.example: 新聞說鄰國又試射了飛彈。
entries.exampleEnglish: The news says a neighboring country test-fired missiles again.
entries.question: 看到飛彈的新聞，你會擔心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you worry when you see news about missiles?
entries.answer: 有一點，看到飛彈的新聞會緊張。
entries.answerEnglish: A little. Missile news makes me nervous.

entries.example: 我們公司的總部在新竹。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company's headquarters are in Hsinchu.
entries.question: 你們公司的總部在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where is your company's headquarters?
entries.answer: 我們公司的總部在台北。
entries.answerEnglish: Our company's headquarters are in Taipei.

entries.example: 衛生檢查員今天來餐廳檢查。
entries.exampleEnglish: A health inspector came to inspect the restaurant today.
entries.question: 你覺得檢查員的工作辛苦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think an inspector's job is hard?
entries.answer: 我覺得檢查員的工作很辛苦。
entries.answerEnglish: I think being an inspector is hard work.

entries.example: 請用濕紙巾擦拭桌面。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please wipe the table with a wet wipe.
entries.question: 你多久擦拭一次手機螢幕？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you wipe your phone screen?
entries.answer: 我每天都會擦拭手機螢幕。
entries.answerEnglish: I wipe my phone screen every day.

entries.example: 每個國家都有自己的憲法。
entries.exampleEnglish: Every country has its own constitution.
entries.question: 你讀過你們國家的憲法嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you read your country's constitution?
entries.answer: 讀過一點，學校教過憲法。
entries.answerEnglish: A little. We learned about the constitution in school.

entries.example: 他最近承受很大的壓力。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's been under a lot of pressure lately.
entries.question: 工作壓力大的時候，你承受得了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When work gets stressful, can you handle it?
entries.answer: 承受得了，我會用運動來減壓。
entries.answerEnglish: I can handle it. I exercise to relieve stress.

entries.example: 我們不應該因為種族歧視別人。
entries.exampleEnglish: We shouldn't discriminate against people because of their race.
entries.question: 你住的城市有很多不同種族嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many different races in the city where you live?
entries.answer: 有，我住的城市有很多不同種族的人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, people of many different races live in my city.

entries.example: 很多青少年喜歡去西門町。
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of teenagers like going to Ximending.
entries.question: 你是青少年的時候喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What did you like to do when you were a teenager?
entries.answer: 我是青少年的時候喜歡打電動。
entries.answerEnglish: When I was a teenager, I liked playing video games.

entries.example: 台灣也發射過人造衛星。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has launched satellites too.
entries.question: 你晚上看過人造衛星飛過天空嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a satellite cross the night sky?
entries.answer: 看過一次，人造衛星飛得很快。
entries.answerEnglish: Once. The satellite moved really fast.

entries.example: 加拿大有十個省。
entries.exampleEnglish: Canada has ten provinces.
entries.question: 你的國家分成很多省嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country divided into many provinces?
entries.answer: 對，我的國家分成十個省。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country is divided into ten provinces.

entries.example: 颱風來之前，要先加固窗戶。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before a typhoon comes, you should reinforce the windows.
entries.question: 颱風天你會加固家裡的窗戶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you reinforce your windows when a typhoon comes?
entries.answer: 會，我會用膠帶加固窗戶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I reinforce the windows with tape.

entries.example: 山上有登山客被虎頭蜂襲擊。
entries.exampleEnglish: Some hikers in the mountains were attacked by hornets.
entries.question: 你被動物襲擊過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been attacked by an animal?
entries.answer: 有，我在海邊被海鷗襲擊過。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was attacked by a seagull at the beach.

entries.example: 他十歲的時候跟家人移民到美國。
entries.exampleEnglish: He moved to the US with his family when he was ten.
entries.question: 你想移民到其他國家嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to emigrate to another country?
entries.answer: 我已經移民到台灣了。
entries.answerEnglish: I've already immigrated to Taiwan.

entries.example: 台南出產很多芒果。
entries.exampleEnglish: Tainan produces lots of mangoes.
entries.question: 你的家鄉出產什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What does your hometown produce?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉出產很多葡萄酒。
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown produces a lot of wine.

entries.example: 因為下雨的緣故，比賽取消了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The game was canceled because of the rain.
entries.question: 你是因為什麼緣故來台灣的？
entries.questionEnglish: What brought you to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 因為工作的緣故，我來到台灣。
entries.answerEnglish: I came to Taiwan because of work.

entries.example: 他的舉動讓大家很感動。
entries.exampleEnglish: What he did really touched everyone.
entries.question: 什麼舉動會讓你覺得沒禮貌？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of behavior do you find rude?
entries.answer: 在捷運上大聲講電話的舉動很沒禮貌。
entries.answerEnglish: Talking loudly on the phone on the MRT is rude.

entries.example: 他的爸爸是個知識分子。
entries.exampleEnglish: His father is an intellectual.
entries.question: 你覺得自己是知識分子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you consider yourself an intellectual?
entries.answer: 不是，我不算是知識分子。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I wouldn't call myself an intellectual.

entries.example: 明天北部會有大範圍降雨。
entries.exampleEnglish: There will be widespread rain in the north tomorrow.
entries.question: 你遇過大範圍停電嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever experienced a widespread blackout?
entries.answer: 遇過，那次大範圍停電好幾個小時。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that big blackout lasted several hours.

entries.example: 會說中文是你找工作的優勢。
entries.exampleEnglish: Speaking Chinese gives you an advantage when job hunting.
entries.question: 你覺得你有什麼優勢？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think your strengths are?
entries.answer: 我的優勢是會說三種語言。
entries.answerEnglish: My advantage is that I speak three languages.

entries.example: 他上個月辭職了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He quit his job last month.
entries.question: 你辭職過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever quit a job?
entries.answer: 我辭職過一次，因為工作太累了。
entries.answerEnglish: I quit once because the job was too exhausting.

entries.example: 他最後被法院定罪了。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the end he was convicted by the court.
entries.question: 你覺得沒有證據可以定罪嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think someone can be convicted without evidence?
entries.answer: 不行，沒有證據就不能定罪。
entries.answerEnglish: No, you can't convict anyone without evidence.

entries.example: 我爸爸以前是工廠的機器操作員。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad used to be a machine operator in a factory.
entries.question: 你覺得機器操作員的工作難嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think working as a machine operator is hard?
entries.answer: 我覺得機器操作員要非常小心。
entries.answerEnglish: I think machine operators have to be very careful.

entries.example: 我每週打一次網球。
entries.exampleEnglish: I play tennis once a week.
entries.question: 你會打網球嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play tennis?
entries.answer: 會，我每個週末都打網球。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I play tennis every weekend.

entries.example: 我大學念的是心理學。
entries.exampleEnglish: I studied psychology at university.
entries.question: 你對心理學有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in psychology?
entries.answer: 有，我常看心理學的書。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often read psychology books.

entries.example: 警察終於抓到兇手了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police finally caught the killer.
entries.question: 看推理小說時，你常猜到兇手嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you read mystery novels, do you often guess the killer?
entries.answer: 常常猜不到，兇手都讓我很意外。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually can't. The killer always surprises me.

entries.example: 朋友之間要相互尊重。
entries.exampleEnglish: Friends should respect each other.
entries.question: 你覺得夫妻需要相互信任嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think couples need to trust each other?
entries.answer: 當然需要，夫妻要相互信任。
entries.answerEnglish: Of course. Couples need to trust each other.

entries.example: 這座老磨坊現在變成咖啡店了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This old mill has been turned into a coffee shop.
entries.question: 你參觀過老磨坊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited an old mill?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我在荷蘭看過風車磨坊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I saw a windmill in the Netherlands.

entries.example: 我工作時喜歡聽古典音樂。
entries.exampleEnglish: I like listening to classical music while I work.
entries.question: 你喜歡聽古典音樂嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like listening to classical music?
entries.answer: 喜歡，古典音樂讓我很放鬆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, classical music relaxes me.

entries.example: 我相信命運是自己決定的。
entries.exampleEnglish: I believe we decide our own fate.
entries.question: 你相信命運嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in fate?
entries.answer: 我不太相信命運。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't really believe in fate.

entries.example: 少開車可以減少碳排放。
entries.exampleEnglish: Driving less can cut carbon emissions.
entries.question: 你會想辦法減少碳排放嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you try to cut your carbon emissions?
entries.answer: 會，我常搭捷運來減少碳排放。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often take the MRT to cut carbon emissions.

entries.example: 他參加了全國羽球錦標賽。
entries.exampleEnglish: He took part in the national badminton championship.
entries.question: 你看過什麼錦標賽？
entries.questionEnglish: What tournaments have you watched?
entries.answer: 我去現場看過網球錦標賽。
entries.answerEnglish: I've watched a tennis tournament live.

entries.example: 新竹有很多做精密儀器的公司。
entries.exampleEnglish: Hsinchu has lots of companies that make precision instruments.
entries.question: 你會修理精密的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you repair delicate, precise things?
entries.answer: 不會，手錶這種精密的東西我不會修。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can't fix precise things like watches.

entries.example: 我在學彈吉他。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm learning to play the guitar.
entries.question: 你會彈吉他嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play the guitar?
entries.answer: 會一點，我每天練吉他。
entries.answerEnglish: A little. I practice guitar every day.

entries.example: 台東的農業很發達。
entries.exampleEnglish: Farming is well developed in Taitung.
entries.question: 你的家鄉以農業為主嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is farming the main industry in your hometown?
entries.answer: 是的，我的家鄉以農業為主。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my hometown is mainly agricultural.

entries.example: 她是動物權益的倡議者。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's an advocate for animal rights.
entries.question: 你想當哪個議題的倡議者？
entries.questionEnglish: What issue would you like to be an advocate for?
entries.answer: 我想當環保議題的倡議者。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to be an advocate for the environment.

entries.example: 警察查扣了一批假貨。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police seized a batch of counterfeit goods.
entries.question: 你的東西在機場被查扣過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has anything of yours ever been confiscated at an airport?
entries.answer: 有，我帶的水果在機場被查扣了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the fruit I brought was confiscated at the airport.

entries.example: 我聽得懂他們的對話。
entries.exampleEnglish: I can understand their conversation.
entries.question: 你能用中文跟店員對話嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you have a conversation with shop staff in Chinese?
entries.answer: 可以，簡單的對話沒問題。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, simple conversations are no problem.

entries.example: 他昏倒以後失去了意識。
entries.exampleEnglish: He lost consciousness after he fainted.
entries.question: 你有環保意識嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you environmentally conscious?
entries.answer: 有，我的環保意識很強。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm very environmentally conscious.

entries.example: 這間房子的所有權是我爸爸的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This house belongs to my father.
entries.question: 你住的房子所有權是你的嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you own the home you live in?
entries.answer: 不是，我住的房子所有權是房東的。
entries.answerEnglish: No, the landlord owns the place I live in.

entries.example: 這件衣服洗了幾次就褪色了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shirt faded after just a few washes.
entries.question: 你的衣服常常褪色嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do your clothes fade often?
entries.answer: 有些便宜的衣服很容易褪色。
entries.answerEnglish: Some cheap clothes fade easily.

entries.example: 這場車禍真是一場悲劇。
entries.exampleEnglish: This car accident was a real tragedy.
entries.question: 你喜歡看悲劇電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching tragic movies?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，悲劇電影讓我很難過。
entries.answerEnglish: No, tragedies make me too sad.

entries.example: 週末我想逃離城市，去山上走走。
entries.exampleEnglish: This weekend I want to escape the city and go walk in the mountains.
entries.question: 你會想逃離忙碌的生活嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you ever want to escape your busy life?
entries.answer: 會，我常想逃離台北的人潮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often want to escape the crowds in Taipei.

entries.example: 她穿得很樸素。
entries.exampleEnglish: She dresses very plainly.
entries.question: 你喜歡樸素的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like plain, simple clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我平常都穿得很樸素。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually dress very simply.

entries.example: 店家答應賠償我的損失。
entries.exampleEnglish: The shop agreed to compensate me for my loss.
entries.question: 你要求過別人賠償嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever asked someone for compensation?
entries.answer: 有，搬家公司弄壞桌子，有賠償我。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the movers broke my table and paid me for it.

entries.example: 我們在船的甲板上看海。
entries.exampleEnglish: We watched the sea from the ship's deck.
entries.question: 坐船時，你喜歡站在甲板上嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you take a boat, do you like standing on the deck?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡在甲板上吹海風。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love feeling the sea breeze on deck.

entries.english: voluntary; volunteer to; of one's own free will
entries.example: 加班是自願的，不是強迫的。
entries.exampleEnglish: Overtime is voluntary, not compulsory.
entries.question: 你會自願幫同事做事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you volunteer to help your coworkers?
entries.answer: 會，我常自願幫同事。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often offer to help my coworkers.

entries.example: 冷氣不動了，可能是電路有問題。
entries.exampleEnglish: The air conditioner stopped working; maybe there's a wiring problem.
entries.question: 你會自己修理電路嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you fix electrical wiring yourself?
entries.answer: 不會，電路壞了我會找水電工。
entries.answerEnglish: No, when the wiring breaks I call an electrician.

entries.example: 我小時候很愛看希臘神話。
entries.exampleEnglish: When I was little, I loved reading Greek myths.
entries.question: 你知道哪些有名的神話？
entries.questionEnglish: What famous myths do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道很多希臘神話的故事。
entries.answerEnglish: I know a lot of stories from Greek mythology.

entries.example: 電梯裡貼了停水的公告。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a notice in the elevator about a water outage.
entries.question: 你會看大樓的公告嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you read the notices in your building?
entries.answer: 會，我每天都會看電梯裡的公告。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I read the notices in the elevator every day.

entries.example: 我常幻想自己中樂透。
entries.exampleEnglish: I often daydream about winning the lottery.
entries.question: 你常幻想什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you often daydream about?
entries.answer: 我常幻想自己住在海邊。
entries.answerEnglish: I often daydream about living by the sea.

entries.example: 我偶爾會去夜市吃東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: I go to the night market to eat once in a while.
entries.question: 你偶爾會自己做飯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cook for yourself once in a while?
entries.answer: 會，我偶爾週末自己做飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I sometimes cook on weekends.

entries.example: 他看著帳單一直嘆氣。
entries.exampleEnglish: He kept sighing as he looked at the bill.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會嘆氣？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you sigh?
entries.answer: 星期一早上我常常嘆氣。
entries.answerEnglish: I sigh a lot on Monday mornings.

entries.example: 這個新規定很有爭議。
entries.exampleEnglish: This new rule is very controversial.
entries.question: 你的國家最近有什麼爭議？
entries.questionEnglish: What controversies are there in your country lately?
entries.answer: 最近大家對核電很有爭議。
entries.answerEnglish: Lately, nuclear power has been a hot topic of debate.

entries.example: 他酒駕鬧事，被送進拘留所。
entries.exampleEnglish: He drove drunk and caused trouble, so he was taken to a detention center.
entries.question: 你覺得拘留所跟監獄一樣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think a detention center is the same as a prison?
entries.answer: 不一樣，拘留所是暫時關人的地方。
entries.answerEnglish: No, a detention center only holds people temporarily.

entries.example: 全公司集體去花蓮旅遊。
entries.exampleEnglish: The whole company went on a trip to Hualien together.
entries.question: 你們公司會集體出去玩嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company go on trips together?
entries.answer: 會，我們每年集體去員工旅遊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we all go on a company trip every year.

entries.example: 遇到困難，大家要團結。
entries.exampleEnglish: When things get hard, everyone needs to stick together.
entries.question: 你覺得你們的團隊團結嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your team is united?
entries.answer: 很團結，大家都會互相幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: Very united. Everyone helps each other.

entries.example: 這首歌是他自己作曲的。
entries.exampleEnglish: He wrote the music for this song himself.
entries.question: 你會作曲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you compose music?
entries.answer: 不會，可是我很想學作曲。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd really like to learn to compose.

entries.example: 立法院通過了新的修正案。
entries.exampleEnglish: The Legislative Yuan passed a new amendment.
entries.question: 你關心立法院的修正案嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you follow the amendments passed by the Legislative Yuan?
entries.answer: 不太關心，修正案太難懂了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Amendments are too hard to understand.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的競爭者很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: This coffee shop has a lot of competitors.
entries.question: 你的工作有很多競爭者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there a lot of competitors in your line of work?
entries.answer: 有，我這行的競爭者很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are lots of competitors in my field.

entries.example: 他是個很老練的業務。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very seasoned salesman.
entries.question: 你覺得自己做事老練嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you handle things like a seasoned pro?
entries.answer: 還不夠老練，我還在學習。
entries.answerEnglish: Not experienced enough yet. I'm still learning.

entries.example: 冬天的樹枝光禿禿的。
entries.exampleEnglish: The branches are bare in winter.
entries.question: 你看過光禿禿的山嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a bare mountain?
entries.answer: 看過，那座山光禿禿的，沒有樹。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, that mountain was bare, with no trees.

entries.example: 除了咖啡，我也喜歡喝茶。
entries.exampleEnglish: Besides coffee, I also like tea.
entries.question: 除了中文，你還會說什麼語言？
entries.questionEnglish: Besides Chinese, what other languages do you speak?
entries.answer: 除了中文，我還會說法文。
entries.answerEnglish: Besides Chinese, I also speak French.

entries.example: 這個政治人物最近有醜聞。
entries.exampleEnglish: This politician has been caught up in a scandal lately.
entries.question: 你最近看到什麼醜聞的新聞？
entries.questionEnglish: What scandals have you seen in the news lately?
entries.answer: 我看到一個明星的醜聞。
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a scandal about a celebrity.

entries.example: 我很喜歡看偵探小說。
entries.exampleEnglish: I love reading detective novels.
entries.question: 你喜歡看偵探電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like detective movies?
entries.answer: 喜歡，偵探電影很刺激。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, detective movies are exciting.

entries.example: 歷史上，這個國家常被侵略。
entries.exampleEnglish: Throughout history, this country was often invaded.
entries.question: 你的國家以前被侵略過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your country ever been invaded?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家以前被侵略過。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country was invaded in the past.

entries.example: 路上有個大坑，騎車要小心。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big hole in the road, so be careful on your scooter.
entries.question: 你家附近的路上有坑嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there holes in the roads near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家附近的路上有好幾個坑。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are several holes in the road near my home.

entries.example: 警察抓到了兩個恐怖分子。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police caught two terrorists.
entries.question: 你搭飛機時會擔心恐怖分子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you worry about terrorists when you fly?
entries.answer: 不會，我不太擔心恐怖分子。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't really worry about terrorists.

entries.example: 辦公室裡常常有笑聲。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's often laughter in the office.
entries.question: 你家裡常常有笑聲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there often laughter in your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家裡每天都有笑聲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's laughter in my home every day.

entries.example: 萬聖節他戴了一個可怕的面具。
entries.exampleEnglish: He wore a scary mask for Halloween.
entries.question: 萬聖節你會戴面具嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear a mask on Halloween?
entries.answer: 會，我去年戴了一個鬼面具。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year I wore a ghost mask.

entries.example: 我在航空展看到了戰鬥機。
entries.exampleEnglish: I saw fighter jets at the air show.
entries.question: 你看過戰鬥機飛過天空嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a fighter jet fly overhead?
entries.answer: 看過，戰鬥機飛過去的聲音很大。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, fighter jets are really loud when they fly past.

entries.example: 新兵要接受很辛苦的訓練。
entries.exampleEnglish: New recruits go through tough training.
entries.question: 你覺得新兵訓練辛苦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think basic training for new recruits is tough?
entries.answer: 很辛苦，我當新兵的時候每天都很累。
entries.answerEnglish: Very tough. When I was a new recruit, I was exhausted every day.

entries.example: 我們要把兩個部門整合起來。
entries.exampleEnglish: We need to merge the two departments.
entries.question: 你會用App整合你的行程嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use an app to bring all your plans together?
entries.answer: 會，我用一個App整合所有行程。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I use one app to keep all my plans in one place.

entries.example: 他是一個很可靠的同事。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very dependable coworker.
entries.question: 你覺得自己可靠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're reliable?
entries.answer: 我覺得我很可靠，朋友常找我幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm very reliable; my friends often ask me for help.

entries.example: 有問題可以問警察。
entries.exampleEnglish: If you have a problem, you can ask a police officer.
entries.question: 你在台灣跟警察說過話嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever talked to a police officer in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 說過，我問過警察怎麼走。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once asked a police officer for directions.

entries.example: 我第一次去國家戲劇院看歌劇。
entries.exampleEnglish: I went to the National Theater to see an opera for the first time.
entries.question: 你喜歡看歌劇嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like going to the opera?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我每年都去看一次歌劇。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go to an opera once a year.

entries.example: 一架噴射機從頭上飛過去。
entries.exampleEnglish: A jet flew overhead.
entries.question: 你坐過私人噴射機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever flown on a private jet?
entries.answer: 沒有，我從來沒坐過私人噴射機。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never been on a private jet.

entries.example: 這部分我看不懂。
entries.exampleEnglish: I don't understand this part.
entries.question: 你覺得中文哪個部分最難？
entries.questionEnglish: Which part of Chinese do you find hardest?
entries.answer: 我覺得寫字的部分最難。
entries.answerEnglish: I think writing characters is the hardest part.

entries.example: 國會今天在討論新的法律。
entries.exampleEnglish: Parliament is debating a new law today.
entries.question: 你會注意國會的新聞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you follow news about parliament?
entries.answer: 偶爾會，我會看國會的新聞。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I read news about parliament.

entries.example: 新聞報導了一起強暴案。
entries.exampleEnglish: The news reported a rape case.
entries.question: 你覺得強暴犯應該判多重？
entries.questionEnglish: How heavily do you think rapists should be sentenced?
entries.answer: 我覺得強暴犯應該判很重。
entries.answerEnglish: I think rapists should get very heavy sentences.

entries.example: 這條街以前很繁榮。
entries.exampleEnglish: This street used to be very prosperous.
entries.question: 你的家鄉繁榮嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your hometown prosperous?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉很繁榮，有很多商店。
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown is thriving; it has lots of shops.

entries.example: 在山洞裡大叫會有回音。
entries.exampleEnglish: If you shout in a cave, you'll hear an echo.
entries.question: 你在哪裡聽過回音？
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you heard an echo?
entries.answer: 我在山谷裡聽過回音。
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard an echo in a valley.

entries.example: 直升機把受傷的人送到醫院。
entries.exampleEnglish: A helicopter took the injured person to the hospital.
entries.question: 你坐過直升機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been in a helicopter?
entries.answer: 沒有，可是我很想坐直升機。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd really like to ride in a helicopter.

entries.example: 他否認了所有的指控。
entries.exampleEnglish: He denied all the accusations.
entries.question: 你被別人錯誤指控過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been wrongly accused?
entries.answer: 有，同事曾經指控我偷吃他的便當。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a coworker once accused me of eating his lunch box.

entries.example: 她送我一顆漂亮的水晶。
entries.exampleEnglish: She gave me a beautiful crystal.
entries.question: 你相信水晶會帶來好運嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe crystals bring good luck?
entries.answer: 不太相信，可是我覺得水晶很漂亮。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, but I think crystals are pretty.

entries.example: 這家公司做零售，也做批發。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company does both retail and wholesale.
entries.question: 你做過零售業的工作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worked in retail?
entries.answer: 做過，我以前在零售業當店員。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to work as a sales clerk in retail.

entries.example: 小狗在草地上開心地跳躍。
entries.exampleEnglish: The puppy is happily leaping around on the grass.
entries.question: 你喜歡做有跳躍動作的運動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like exercise that involves jumping?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，跳躍對我的膝蓋不好。
entries.answerEnglish: No, jumping is bad for my knees.

entries.example: 我家附近有一間廟。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a temple near my home.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的廟嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to a temple in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 去過，我常去家附近的廟拜拜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often go to pray at the temple near my home.

entries.example: 我在捷運站等你。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'll wait for you at the MRT station.
entries.question: 你等過朋友很久嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever waited a long time for a friend?
entries.answer: 有，我等了朋友一個小時。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once waited an hour for a friend.

entries.example: 她緊張得緊握著我的手。
entries.exampleEnglish: She was so nervous she gripped my hand tightly.
entries.question: 坐雲霄飛車時，你會緊握扶手嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: On a roller coaster, do you grip the handlebar tight?
entries.answer: 會，我會緊握扶手，閉上眼睛。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I grip the handlebar and close my eyes.

entries.example: 颱風過後，海邊有很多漂流木。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the typhoon, there was lots of driftwood on the beach.
entries.question: 你看過在海上漂流的垃圾嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen trash drifting in the sea?
entries.answer: 看過，我在海邊看到很多漂流的垃圾。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen lots of drifting trash at the beach.

entries.example: 市議會今天在討論新的捷運線。
entries.exampleEnglish: The city council is discussing a new MRT line today.
entries.question: 你住的城市有議會嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does the city you live in have a council?
entries.answer: 有，我住的城市有市議會。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my city has a city council.

entries.example: 家裡的垃圾桶滿了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The trash can at home is full.
entries.question: 你家有幾個垃圾桶？
entries.questionEnglish: How many trash cans do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我家有三個垃圾桶。
entries.answerEnglish: We have three trash cans at home.

entries.example: 這個App每月要付一百元。
entries.exampleEnglish: This app costs a hundred dollars a month.
entries.question: 你每月花多少錢吃飯？
entries.questionEnglish: How much do you spend on food each month?
entries.answer: 我每月大概花一萬元吃飯。
entries.answerEnglish: I spend about ten thousand dollars a month on food.

entries.example: 手機帶來了一場生活革命。
entries.exampleEnglish: Smartphones brought about a revolution in daily life.
entries.question: 你覺得AI會帶來革命嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think AI will bring about a revolution?
entries.answer: 會，AI會帶來很大的革命。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, AI will bring a huge revolution.

entries.example: 我們公司分成三個小隊比賽。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our company split into three teams to compete.
entries.question: 你參加過什麼小隊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been part of a team or squad?
entries.answer: 我參加過公司的籃球小隊。
entries.answerEnglish: I've been on my company's basketball team.

entries.example: 他因為詐欺被警察抓了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was arrested by the police for fraud.
entries.question: 你覺得網路詐欺多嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think there's a lot of online fraud?
entries.answer: 很多，網路詐欺越來越多了。
entries.answerEnglish: A lot. Online fraud keeps increasing.

entries.example: 我迫不及待想去夜市吃東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: I can't wait to go eat at the night market.
entries.question: 你迫不及待想做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What can't you wait to do?
entries.answer: 我迫不及待想去日本旅行。
entries.answerEnglish: I can't wait to travel to Japan.

entries.example: 這部電影的劇本寫得很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: This movie's script is very well written.
entries.question: 你想寫電影劇本嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to write a screenplay?
entries.answer: 想，我想寫一個愛情劇本。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to write a romance script.

entries.example: 這樣分不公平！
entries.exampleEnglish: Splitting it like this isn't fair!
entries.question: 你覺得你的公司公平嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your company is fair?
entries.answer: 我覺得我的公司很公平。
entries.answerEnglish: I think my company is very fair.

entries.example: 晚上潮水會漲到這裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the evening the tide comes up to here.
entries.question: 去海邊玩時，你會注意潮水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you go to the beach, do you keep an eye on the tide?
entries.answer: 會，我會先查潮水的時間。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check the tide times first.

entries.example: 這家公司剝削員工，常常不給加班費。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company exploits its staff and often doesn't pay overtime.
entries.question: 你覺得你被老闆剝削過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel you've ever been exploited by a boss?
entries.answer: 有，以前的老闆常剝削我們。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my old boss often exploited us.

entries.example: 這個計畫下週開始執行。
entries.exampleEnglish: This plan will be carried out starting next week.
entries.question: 你做了計畫以後都會執行嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you always follow through on your plans?
entries.answer: 不一定，有時候我做了計畫卻沒執行。
entries.answerEnglish: Not always. Sometimes I make plans but don't carry them out.

entries.example: 雨太大了，我們先撤退吧！
entries.exampleEnglish: The rain's too heavy. Let's retreat for now!
entries.question: 爬山遇到大雨，你會撤退嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: If it pours while you're hiking, do you turn back?
entries.answer: 會，下大雨我一定馬上撤退。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if it pours I always turn back right away.

entries.example: 我昨天晚上做了一個惡夢。
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a nightmare last night.
entries.question: 你常做惡夢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often have nightmares?
entries.answer: 不常，我很少做惡夢。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often. I rarely have nightmares.

entries.example: 很多人譴責這種行為。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many people condemn this kind of behavior.
entries.question: 你會在網路上譴責別人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you ever condemn people online?
entries.answer: 不會，我不喜歡在網路上譴責別人。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like condemning people online.

entries.example: 加入協會前要先看章程。
entries.exampleEnglish: Read the charter before joining the association.
entries.question: 你參加的社團有章程嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does the club you belong to have a charter?
entries.answer: 有，我們的社團有一份章程。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our club has a charter.

entries.example: 他是一個社會主義者。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a socialist.
entries.question: 你身邊有社會主義者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know any socialists?
entries.answer: 有，我大學同學是社會主義者。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a classmate from university is a socialist.

entries.example: 我在公司當行銷專員。
entries.exampleEnglish: I work as a marketing specialist at my company.
entries.question: 你的職稱是專員嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your job title "specialist"?
entries.answer: 對，我是人資專員。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm an HR specialist.

entries.example: 我哥哥在銀行業工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: My older brother works in banking.
entries.question: 你想在銀行業工作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to work in banking?
entries.answer: 不想，我覺得銀行業壓力很大。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I think banking is very stressful.

entries.example: 他很不情願地去加班。
entries.exampleEnglish: He went to work overtime very reluctantly.
entries.question: 你做過什麼不情願的事？
entries.questionEnglish: What have you done reluctantly?
entries.answer: 我很不情願地參加了尾牙表演。
entries.answerEnglish: I very reluctantly performed at the year-end company party.

entries.example: 最後我們兩個都妥協了。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the end we both compromised.
entries.question: 你跟家人吵架時會妥協嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you compromise when you argue with family?
entries.answer: 會，我通常會先妥協。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm usually the first to compromise.

entries.example: 這場比賽由一家銀行贊助。
entries.exampleEnglish: This competition is sponsored by a bank.
entries.question: 你贊助過什麼活動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever sponsored anything?
entries.answer: 有，我每個月贊助一個慈善團體。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I support a charity every month.

entries.example: 這篇新聞的標題很誇張。
entries.exampleEnglish: This news story's headline is really over the top.
entries.question: 你看新聞時只看標題嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you read the news, do you only read the headlines?
entries.answer: 有時候，我太忙就只看標題。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. When I'm too busy, I only read the headlines.

entries.example: 去年雞蛋短缺，很難買到。
entries.exampleEnglish: Last year there was an egg shortage, and eggs were hard to find.
entries.question: 你遇過什麼東西短缺嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever experienced a shortage of something?
entries.answer: 遇過，有一陣子雞蛋短缺，很難買。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, for a while there was an egg shortage and they were hard to buy.

entries.example: 他說話的語氣很和緩。
entries.exampleEnglish: He speaks in a calm, gentle tone.
entries.question: 你跟人吵架時語氣和緩嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep a calm tone when arguing with someone?
entries.answer: 我會盡量讓語氣和緩一點。
entries.answerEnglish: I try to keep my tone a bit calmer.

entries.example: 下大雨時，排水溝的水都滿了。
entries.exampleEnglish: When it pours, the gutters fill right up.
entries.question: 你家門口的排水溝會塞住嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does the drain outside your home get blocked?
entries.answer: 會，颱風天排水溝常常塞住。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it often gets blocked on typhoon days.

entries.example: 她在比賽中拿到了一面獎牌。
entries.exampleEnglish: She won a medal in the competition.
entries.question: 你得過獎牌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever won a medal?
entries.answer: 得過，我跑馬拉松拿過一面獎牌。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got a medal for running a marathon.

entries.example: 他在外交部工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: He works at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
entries.question: 你對外交工作有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in diplomatic work?
entries.answer: 有，我很想從事外交工作。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd really like to work in diplomacy.

entries.example: 淹水的時候要用抽水機。
entries.exampleEnglish: When it floods, you need a water pump.
entries.question: 你家有抽水機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a water pump at home?
entries.answer: 沒有，可是我們大樓有抽水機。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but our building has a water pump.

entries.example: 她是台灣很有名的女演員。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a very famous actress in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位女演員？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite actress?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡一位韓國女演員。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite is a Korean actress.

entries.example: 我們家每年的總收入不高。
entries.exampleEnglish: Our household's total yearly income isn't high.
entries.question: 你知道你一年的總收入嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know your total yearly income?
entries.answer: 知道，報稅的時候我會算總收入。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I work out my total income when I file my taxes.

entries.example: 新台幣是台灣的貨幣。
entries.exampleEnglish: The New Taiwan dollar is Taiwan's currency.
entries.question: 你們國家用什麼貨幣？
entries.questionEnglish: What currency does your country use?
entries.answer: 我們國家的貨幣是歐元。
entries.answerEnglish: Our country's currency is the euro.

entries.example: 這個洞穴裡住著很多蝙蝠。
entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of bats live in this cave.
entries.question: 你去過洞穴探險嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever gone exploring in a cave?
entries.answer: 去過，我在越南進過一個大洞穴。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I went into a huge cave in Vietnam.

entries.example: 花椰菜的莖也可以吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can eat broccoli stems too.
entries.question: 你吃花椰菜時會吃莖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat the stem when you eat broccoli?
entries.answer: 會，我覺得花椰菜的莖很好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think broccoli stems are tasty.

entries.example: 這是一架民用飛機。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a civilian aircraft.
entries.question: 你覺得民用無人機要管嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think civilian drones should be regulated?
entries.answer: 要管，民用無人機不能亂飛。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, civilian drones shouldn't fly just anywhere.

entries.example: 山上的獵人很了解動物。
entries.exampleEnglish: The hunters in the mountains know a lot about animals.
entries.question: 你的國家有很多獵人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there many hunters in your country?
entries.answer: 有，我的國家有不少獵人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are quite a few hunters in my country.
